levels.title: What counts as a split?
levels.body_md: Think about what each part must satisfy.
levels.question_back: What does a valid part look like?

levels.title: Look at the structure
levels.body_md: Both parts must be positive and even. Consider how these requirements interact.

levels.title: Use parity
levels.body_md: Parity reasoning fits because the condition concerns even weights and their sum.

levels.title: Build the reasoning
levels.body_md: Consider the smallest valid parts, then reason about the parity of their sum and whether the total can accommodate both. This takes constant time and constant space.
